Subject: Q3 forecast integrity — stage lock prep and orphan deal sweep

Team,

We have one week before finance closes the Q3 commit window. Quick, targeted sweep to keep the forecast credible: please action the items below by EOD Monday (2026-08-09). No long write-ups — just 1-line updates in the sheet attached.

Top asks (15–30 min per rep):
- Update any opportunity where the next-step is >21 days old: set correct Stage or mark as Stalled/Archive.
- For opportunities >90 days with no activity, either: (a) reassign to the appropriate owner, (b) archive, or (c) confirm active with a firm close-date and next-step.
- Confirm any late-stage (Proposal/Negotiation) deals have a committed PO date and internal risk note (reason for confidence).

Attached: stale-opps-report (filtered by last-activity and age) + forecast-commit-template. Use the template to declare Commit/Best/Upside. I’ll pull a rollup Tuesday AM.

Notes on exceptions: if you have a customer-side procurement hold (contract/legal) that actually blocks close, mark the opp as "Procurement Hold" not Commit. Finance will not count those as committed.

Example quick update line: ACME-4821 | Proposal | $120k | 2026-08-27 | Committed | PO pending from Samantha (procurement).

Ping me for tricky situations — I’ll escalate to CS or Legal if needed.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com | x-4291
